name: Aggregate
description: Combines all items into one array field.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.mode }}

properties.name: mode
properties.description: What to collect into the output array.

properties.name: sourceField
properties.description: Field to collect values from, one per input item.

properties.name: destinationField
properties.description: Field on the output item to hold the aggregated array.

properties.name: batchSize
properties.description: Split into multiple output items of this many aggregated rows each. 0 means one output item for everything.

name: Code
description: Run a JavaScript snippet against the input items.

properties.name: code
properties.description: JavaScript. In 'Run Once for All Items' mode, `items` is an array of the input item JSON and the snippet's value becomes the output. In 'Run Once per Item' mode, `item` is a single item's JSON. The result must be an object or an array of objects.

name: Compare Datasets
description: Diffs two inputs by a key field.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.keyField }}

properties.name: keyField
properties.description: Field present on both inputs to match items by.

name: Crypto
description: Hashes, signs, encodes, or generates random values.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.action }}

properties.name: action
properties.description: What to do with the input field's value.

properties.name: algorithm
properties.description: Hash algorithm used for Hash/HMAC.

properties.name: secretField
properties.description: Plain-text HMAC key. Not a credential -- use a Credential or secret Variable if this value itself is sensitive.

properties.name: inputField
properties.description: Field on each input item to read the value from.

properties.name: length
properties.description: Number of hex characters to generate.

properties.name: destinationField
properties.description: Field on the output item to write the result to.

name: Date & Time
description: Formats, shifts, or diffs date/time values.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.operation }}

properties.name: operation
properties.description: Which date/time transformation to apply.

properties.name: inputField
properties.description: Field holding an ISO-8601 string or epoch seconds.

properties.name: compareField
properties.description: Field holding the timestamp to diff against.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Negative to subtract.

properties.name: unit
properties.description: Unit for Amount (Add/Subtract) or the result (Difference).

properties.name: format
properties.description: Python strftime format string for the output.

properties.name: destinationField
properties.description: Field on the output item to write the result to.

name: Error Trigger
description: Runs this workflow when a linked workflow fails.

name: Execute Workflow
description: Runs another workflow as a sub-workflow.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.workflowId }}

properties.name: workflowId
properties.description: The id of the workflow to run.

name: Filter
description: Keeps only the items matching a condition.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.value1 }} {{ $parameter.operator }} {{ $parameter.value2 }}

properties.name: value1
properties.description: Left-hand side of the comparison.

properties.name: operator
properties.description: How Value 1 and Value 2 are compared.

properties.name: value2
properties.description: Right-hand side of the comparison.

name: HTML Extract
description: Extracts text or attributes from HTML using a CSS selector.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.cssSelector }}

properties.name: sourceField
properties.description: Field on each input item holding an HTML string.

properties.name: cssSelector
properties.description: CSS selector for the element(s) to extract.

properties.name: attribute
properties.description: Extract this attribute's value instead of the element's text (e.g. "href").

properties.name: destinationField
properties.description: Field on the output item to write the extracted value(s) to.

name: HTTP Request
description: Make an HTTP request to any URL.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.method }} {{ $parameter.url }}

properties.name: credentialId
properties.description: Optional. Applied via the credential's declared auth.

name: IF
description: Routes items to true/false outputs based on a condition.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.value1 }} {{ $parameter.operator }} {{ $parameter.value2 }}

name: Limit
description: Keeps only the first or last N items.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.keep }} {{ $parameter.maxItems }}

properties.name: maxItems
properties.description: Maximum number of items to keep.

properties.name: keep
properties.description: Which end of the list to keep items from.

name: Manual Trigger
description: Runs the workflow when you click Test in the editor.

name: Markdown
description: Converts a field between Markdown and HTML.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.direction }}

properties.name: direction
properties.description: Which way to convert.

properties.name: sourceField
properties.description: Field on each input item holding the source text.

properties.name: destinationField
properties.description: Field on the output item to write the converted text to.

name: Merge
description: Combines two input branches into one.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.mode }}

properties.name: mode
properties.description: How to combine Input 1 and Input 2.

properties.name: keyField
properties.description: Field present on both inputs to match items by.

name: No-Op
description: Does nothing. Useful for organizing a graph visually.

name: Postgres
description: Runs a SQL query against a Postgres database.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.query }}

properties.name: credentialId
properties.description: Postgres connection to run the query against.

properties.name: query
properties.description: Use %(name)s placeholders bound from Query Parameters.

properties.name: queryParameters
properties.description: Object of placeholder name -> value.

name: Redis
description: Reads or writes a key in Redis.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.operation }} {{ $parameter.key }}

properties.name: credentialId
properties.description: Redis connection to run the operation against.

properties.name: operation
properties.description: Redis command to run.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Redis key (or channel, for Publish).

properties.name: value
properties.description: Value to write.

properties.name: ttlSeconds
properties.description: Expiry, in seconds.

properties.name: destinationField
properties.description: Field on the output item to write the result to.

name: Remove Duplicates
description: Keeps only the first item for each distinct value.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.compareField }}

properties.name: compareField
properties.description: Field to compare items by. Leave empty to compare each item's entire JSON body.

name: Schedule
description: Starts the workflow on a cron schedule.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.cron }}

properties.name: cron
properties.description: Standard 5-field cron syntax.

properties.name: catchUp
properties.description: If the worker was down when due, run once on restart.

name: Set
description: Build or reshape item JSON.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.mode }}

properties.name: fields
properties.description: JSON object merged into (or replacing) each item.

name: Sort
description: Orders items by a field.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.sortField }} ({{ $parameter.order }})

properties.name: sortField
properties.description: Field to sort items by.

properties.name: order
properties.description: Sort direction.

name: Split Out
description: Splits an array field into one item per element.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.fieldToSplit }}

properties.name: fieldToSplit
properties.description: Field on each input item that holds an array.

properties.name: includeOtherFields
properties.description: Keep the rest of the source item's fields alongside each split-out element (nested under the same field name if it isn't itself an object).

name: Stop And Error
description: Stops the workflow and reports a custom error message.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.message }}

properties.name: message
properties.description: Message reported as the node's error.
properties.placeholder: Order total exceeds the approval limit

name: Switch
description: Routes each item to one of several outputs based on rules.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.numOutputs }} outputs

properties.name: numOutputs
properties.description: How many numbered rule outputs to use (2-4).

properties.name: value1_0
properties.description: Left-hand side of this rule's comparison. Leave unset to skip this rule slot entirely.

properties.name: operator_0
properties.description: How Value 1 and Value 2 are compared.

properties.name: value2_0
properties.description: Right-hand side of this rule's comparison.

properties.name: value1_1
properties.description: Left-hand side of this rule's comparison. Leave unset to skip this rule slot entirely.

properties.name: operator_1
properties.description: How Value 1 and Value 2 are compared.

properties.name: value2_1
properties.description: Right-hand side of this rule's comparison.

properties.name: value1_2
properties.description: Left-hand side of this rule's comparison. Leave unset to skip this rule slot entirely.

properties.name: operator_2
properties.description: How Value 1 and Value 2 are compared.

properties.name: value2_2
properties.description: Right-hand side of this rule's comparison.

name: Wait
description: Pause for a fixed time, or until resumed externally.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.mode }}

name: Webhook
description: Starts the workflow when an HTTP request hits its URL.
subtitle: ={{ $parameter.method }} /webhook/{{ $parameter.path }}

properties.name: path
properties.description: Left blank to generate a random UUID path.

properties.name: responseMode
properties.description: 'Respond node' mode is a Phase 6 node -- not built yet.

name: Workflow Trigger
description: Runs this workflow when called by an Execute Sub-workflow node.
